description:
Brand Introduction:

Aurum is a premium fashion brand that focuses on crafting timeless, luxurious clothing that embodies elegance, style, and sophistication. With a commitment to quality and sustainability, Aurum creates fashion for the modern, conscious consumer. Our collections blend contemporary designs with classic silhouettes, using high-quality materials to deliver clothing that is both stylish and comfortable.

Product Description:

Aurum offers a carefully curated selection of exclusive clothing, including statement outerwear, sleek casual wear, and versatile pieces that effortlessly transition from day to night. Each garment is crafted with great attention to detail using sustainable fabrics such as organic cotton, ethically sourced wool, and innovative recycled materials. Whether it's a tailored coat, a chic dress, or minimalist loungewear, Aurum's clothing is designed for discerning individuals who value craftsmanship, quality, and versatility.

USP (Unique Selling Point):

  1. Sustainably Crafted: Aurum prioritizes eco-friendly materials and ethical production practices.
  2. Timeless Design: Our fashion transcends fleeting trends, offering versatile pieces that are built to last.
  3. Luxury Quality: Each garment is made from premium fabrics with fine craftsmanship, ensuring durability and a flawless fit.
  4. Exclusive Collections: Aurum releases limited-edition collections, offering an exclusive shopping experience for customers.
  5. Comfort & Style: Aurum’s designs combine comfort with high-end style, ideal for modern lifestyles.

Payment Terms:

  • Commission: Affiliates earn a fixed commission of 10% per sale generated through their affiliate link.
  • Payment Method: Commissions are paid exclusively via bank transfer.
  • Payout Frequency: Payouts are made on a monthly basis.
  • Cookie Duration: 30 days – affiliates earn a commission if the referred customer makes a purchase within 30 days of clicking the affiliate link.

Other Information:

  • Marketing Support: Aurum provides affiliates with high-quality visuals and banners to support brand promotion.
  • Tracking & Reporting: Affiliates have access to a tracking platform where they can monitor sales performance and commissions in real time.
  • No Blogger Collaborations: Aurum partners only with professional affiliates and platforms, not with bloggers or influencers.
